subtitle: Professor Choi Baekjoon teaches a course called 'The Art of Cheating' at Sogang University. This course has a solid reputation for being quite tricky, so some students try to copy other people's answers during exams. The exam takes place in a rectangular classroom that is N rows by M columns in size. The classroom is made up of unit squares of size 1 x 1, each representing one seat. To prevent cheating, Choi Baekjoon devised the following strategy. Assume that every student always copies the answers of whoever sits to their left, right, diagonally up-left, or diagonally up-right — four seats in total. Therefore, the seating arrangement must be laid out so that no student is able to cheat.
